title: Power Pages: plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code edits traditional sites
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, download and upload controls, and qualified statements about pricing and governance are supported. The governance checklist names permission audits and installation reviews that have no corresponding controls-table rows.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a Power Pages plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code supporting traditional non-SPA sites.
claims.quote: The Power Pages plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code now supports creating and editing traditional (non-SPA) Power Pages sites.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is in development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists November CY2026 as the general availability target.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists October CY2026 for preview.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "October CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

Use of the plugin is user-opt-in.
claims.quote: After you install the plugin, restart Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI to access the plugin's skills as slash commands in your agent session.

claims.claim: A licensing model specific to the plugin is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin GitHub Copilot CLI Claude Code pricing licensing cost subscription; opened plugin prerequisites and Power Pages licensing; read platform licensing FAQ results. No plugin-specific licensing model found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No Microsoft charge for the plugin is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin pricing licensing Power Pages capacity; opened plugin guidance and Power Pages licensing; read capacity and licensing FAQ results. No plugin-specific price found; site and coding-service charges are separate.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Coding-agent costs depend on the organisation's plan and billing arrangement.
claims.quote: Your GitHub Pre-Purchase plan automatically uses your GCUs to pay for eligible GitHub usage during its one-year term or until GitHub CUs run out.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents GitHub usage, including GitHub Copilot, being billed through a linked Azure subscription.
claims.quote: All GitHub usage from that organization — including GitHub Copilot and GitHub Actions — flows to that subscription.

claims.claim: Claude Code's billing depends on the service it is configured to use.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing, so idle deployments don't incur charges.

claims.claim: Learn documents a Claude Code configuration using Microsoft Foundry that requires a paid Azure subscription.
claims.quote: To use Claude models in Microsoft Foundry, you must have a paid Azure subscription with a billing account in a country or region where Anthropic offers the models for purchase.

claims.claim: Learn currently describes the plugin for modern single-page application sites.
claims.quote: provides an AI-assisted workflow for creating, deploying, and managing modern single-page application (SPA) sites on Power Pages.

claims.claim: Microsoft warns that generated code and configuration can be inaccurate.
claims.quote: Code and configuration generated by the AI coding agent can be inaccurate.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Learn instructs developers to review, test and validate generated content before approving or deploying it.
claims.quote: Review, test, and validate all generated content before you approve or deploy it. Always review agent proposals before approving them.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Table permissions assigned to web roles control access to Dataverse data.
claims.quote: Table permissions assigned to web roles allow members of the web role to access data that's stored in Dataverse tables.

claims.claim: Permission and web-role assignments can expose data to anonymous visitors.
claims.quote: When the Anonymous users web role is granted access to a table, any user who visits the site can access the data in the table.

claims.claim: The download workflow places site metadata on the developer's local machine.
claims.quote: Support for download/upload of website configuration data to/from the local file system

claims.claim: Downloaded site metadata may contain configuration details.
claims.quote: When you download website content using Microsoft Power Platform CLI, the content is structured in YAML and HTML formats making it easy to customize

claims.claim: Power Platform Tools exposes Download and Upload by right-clicking an active site under Explorer > Power Pages Actions > Active Sites.
claims.quote: Power Pages Actions is available in the pane titled Power Pages Actions in the Explorer sidebar of Visual Studio Code. ... Upload: Uploads local changes back to your environment. ... Download: Downloads the site content to a local folder for offline editing.

claims.claim: pac pages download --path <download-folder> --webSiteId <site-guid> --modelVersion <model-version> downloads site content.
claims.quote: pac pages download --path "C:\portals" --webSiteId f88b70cc-580b-4f1a-87c3-41debefeb902 --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: pac pages upload --path <site-folder> --modelVersion <model-version> uploads site content.
claims.quote: pac pages upload --path "C:\portals\starter-portal" --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: The Visual Studio Code control is a developer UI for site content, not a plugin-specific tenant switch.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Tools adds the capability to configure websites using Visual Studio Code

claims.claim: The developer workflow uses authenticated environment access and is constrained by the developer account's roles.
claims.quote: Your code will only be able to perform operations based on the privileges assigned to the user account through security roles or team membership.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a tenant admin switch for this coding-agent plugin on either UI or automation surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin Copilot Claude tenant admin disable Power Platform API pac admin settings upload audit; Power Pages plugin Power Platform API disable. Opened plugin, Copilot hub and admin API guidance; no plugin-specific switch found.

claims.claim: The plugin's CLI workflow requires access to the target environment.
claims.quote: An authenticated PAC CLI session connected to your target environment.

claims.where: Governance controls; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Power Platform CLI guidance supports checking site configuration into source control.
claims.quote: You can now check in the website configuration to source control and move the website configuration to any environment using Microsoft Power Platform CLI.

claims.claim: Code sites also use the authenticated CLI-based development and deployment approach.
claims.quote: Power Pages SPA sites are managed using the PAC CLI commands upload-code-site and download-code-site.

claims.claim: The workflow includes a third-party AI coding tool.
claims.quote: Anthropic's Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools.

claims.claim: The existing plugin has security review skills.
claims.quote: Run security review | /security-review | Orchestrates the focused security skills and consolidates every finding into a single HTML report.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a plugin-specific upload identifier in the admin center as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin upload audit identifier; Power Pages plugin Copilot Claude tenant admin disable Power Platform API pac admin settings upload audit. Opened plugin, Copilot hub and admin API guidance; no plugin-specific admin-center upload identifier found.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist tells readers to check has a controls-table row.
claims.quote: Run table permission audits after agent changes. Review who has installed the plugin and which environments they target. The table contains only downloading/uploading content and the missing tenant admin switch.
claims.fix: The 'After rollout' steps for table permission audits and reviewing plugin installations and target environments have no corresponding controls-table rows. Do not add rows as part of this correction.
